1.question: Am I eligible to become a CitCom.ai Marketplace provider?
1.answer:
To join the CitCom.ai Marketplace as a service provider, your organisation must meet the following criteria:
  • EU/EEA establishment: Your organisation must be a legally registered entity within the EU/EEA, or have a legal entity established in the EU/EEA (e.g., a subsidiary, branch, or other registered entity).
  • Service ownership: You must offer cloud, edge, or digital services that your organisation owns and operates, not acting solely as a reseller of third-party services.
  • B2B/B2G focus: Your target customers must be businesses, public organisations, or professionals, not individual consumers.

2.question: Are my services eligible to be listed on the CitCom.ai Marketplace?
2.answer:
Your services are eligible to be listed if they meet the mandatory compliance criteria defined by the CitCom.ai compliance framework.

CitCom.ai applies the following compliance profiles:
  • Baseline: Your offering can be listed with a Baseline status if it meets the mandatory criteria through self-attestation (self-assessed compliance), even if it does not have formal certifications.
  • Professional / Professional+: Your offering may qualify for Professional or Professional+ if it is supported by certified compliance evidence (valid certifications). The level achieved depends on the type and number of valid certifications, in line with CitCom.ai requirements.
  • Non-compliant: If your offering fails one or more mandatory compliance criteria—based on self-attestation and/or certification checks—it is classified as non-compliant and cannot be published in the official CitCom.ai catalogue.

Services published on CitCom.ai must meet at least the Baseline compliance requirements.

3.question: Do I need to pay a fee to become a CitCom.ai Marketplace provider?
3.answer:
No. There is currently no upfront fee to join the CitCom.ai Marketplace.

Please note that CitCom.ai does not intervene in the commercial relationship or service delivery but only enables discovery, evaluation, and transactions between providers and customers.

4.question: What information and documentation are required to onboard CitCom.ai as a provider?
4.answer:
To onboard as a provider, you will be asked to provide basic organisational details, nominate key roles, and submit supporting documentation for verification.

Required information
  • Company information: Legal name, VAT number, country, city, registered office address, postal code
  • Legal Representative information: Identification and contact details of the individual legally representing the company
  • Account Administrator information: Identification and contact details of the individual responsible for managing the organisation’s account on CitCom.ai (this can also be the same person as the Legal Representative)

Required documentation

You have to provide the Account Administrator Appointment form duly signed.

If the Appointment form is signed using an eIDAS for legal entity representatives certificate, nothing additional is required from your side. Otherwise, you have to additionally provide evidence of the existence of the company and the capacity to represent the company of the Legal Representative. Typically, this is achieved through the submission of a Certificate of Incorporation of the company, clearly indicating the legal representatives authorised to represent the company. If this information is not reflected in the incorporation document, an additional Power of Attorney (or equivalent document) must be provided. When the original documentation is not issued in English, you will have to submit an English translation of the said documents.

5.question: What is the process for becoming a CitCom.ai Marketplace provider?
5.answer:
The onboarding process is straightforward and can be completed in two steps:

Step 1 – Self-registration
You can quickly create a company account and access the platform. Once you receive your verifiable credentials, you can browse the marketplace, review existing offerings, prices and commercial models, even procure services while starting drafting your own service listings. This step allows you to explore and prepare, but it does not allow you to publish services or sell through the marketplace.

Step 2 – Full onboarding
To publish services and start selling through the CitCom.ai Marketplace, you must complete the full onboarding process by submitting the required company and role information, along with the supporting documentation described above. Once verification is completed and your onboarding is approved, your organisation can publish its services and start selling on the CitCom.ai Marketplace.

6.question: I am registered as a CitCom.ai Marketplace provider. Can I also procure services?
6.answer: Yes. If you are registered as a provider on the CitCom.ai Marketplace, your organisation can also procure services as a customer. The same company account can be used to browse, request offers, and purchase services from other providers on the platform.

eligibility.question: Am I eligible to use the CitCom.ai Marketplace as a customer?
eligibility.answer:
The CitCom.ai Marketplace is designed for organisations or professionals worldwide looking to procure trusted digital services in a transparent environment.

You can use the CitCom.ai Marketplace if you represent:

  • Businesses (B2B) seeking cloud, edge, AI, or digital services
  • Public sector organisations (B2G) such as public administrations, agencies, or research institutions
  • Professional organisations purchasing digital services for operational use

Or you are an individual acting within his/her trade, business or professional activities. That is, an individual not acting as a consumer.

trustworthiness.question: How does CitCom.ai ensure the trustworthiness of the services listed on the Marketplace?
trustworthiness.answer:
Services listed on the CitCom.ai Marketplace are evaluated against the CitCom.ai compliance framework, which helps customers understand the level of compliance and supporting evidence behind each offering.

Each service is assigned a compliance profile, such as:

  • Baseline – The service meets the mandatory compliance requirements through provider self-attestation.
  • Professional / Professional+ – The service is supported by verified certifications and compliance evidence.

This structured approach allows customers to assess services more easily, compare offerings transparently, and select solutions that align with their compliance and governance requirements.

Services that do not meet at least the Baseline Compliance Criteria are not published in the CitCom.ai catalogue.

fee.question: Do I need to pay a fee to become a CitCom.ai Marketplace customer?
fee.answer:
No. There is no fee for organisations and professionals to join and use the CitCom.ai Marketplace as a customer.

Please note that CitCom.ai does not intervene in the commercial relationship or service delivery but only enables discovery, evaluation, and transactions between providers and customers.

process.question: What is the process for becoming a CitCom.ai Marketplace customer?
process.answer:
Customer onboarding is completed in a single step. You provide:

  • Company information (legal name, VAT, address, country)
  • Company Representative information (information of the person acting on behalf of the organisation)

Once submitted, you receive your verifiable credentials and gain full access to the CitCom.ai platform.

If you are a professional (freelancer):

You onboard as an organisation. In this case, the company/legal name should match your professional name (as registered for your professional activity).

provider.question: I am registered as a CitCom.ai Marketplace customer. Can I also be a service provider?
provider.answer:
Yes. If you are already registered as a customer on the CitCom.ai Marketplace, you can also sell services. To do so, you simply need to complete the provider onboarding process.

Your existing company account remains the same. By completing the additional onboarding steps required for providers, such as submitting the necessary company information and documentation, you will gain the ability to publish and offer services on the marketplace.

Once the provider onboarding is completed and verified, your organisation will be able to both procure services and sell its own offerings on CitCom.ai. You can find more information here and onboard as a CitCom.ai Marketplace provider.

dispute.answer:
Contracts for services are established directly between the customer and the provider. Any dispute related to pricing, service delivery, or contractual terms is therefore handled between the contracting parties, in accordance with the terms of their agreement and the applicable law.

CitCom.ai facilitates discovery and engagement between customers and providers and is not a party to the service contract. As such, CitCom.ai does not adjudicate contractual disputes but may, where appropriate, facilitate communication between the parties.
